commanders.name: Dusty
commanders.description: A raccoon tinkerer who can patch up anything with twine and pluck. No strengths, no weaknesses.

power.name: Patch Job
power.description: All units recover 2 HP.

super_power.name: Full Overhaul
super_power.description: All units recover 5 HP, gain +10% attack and +1 movement.

commanders.name: Talon
commanders.description: A hawk who swoops straight in. Direct combat units are strong; indirect ones weak and short-ranged.

power.name: Dive
power.description: Direct combat units gain +10% attack and +1 movement.

super_power.name: Talon Strike
super_power.description: Direct combat units gain +30% attack and +2 movement.

commanders.name: Bandit
commanders.description: A raccoon scout who lives off the land. Foot soldiers fight and capture well, transports move further; other direct units are weaker.

power.name: Quick March
power.description: Foot soldiers gain +1 movement and +10% attack.

super_power.name: Midnight Raid
super_power.description: Foot soldiers gain +2 movement, +30% attack, and capture in a single turn.

commanders.name: Clover
commanders.description: An opossum captain blessed with uncanny luck. Her attacks can deal surprising damage.

power.name: Four-Leaf
power.description: Luck rises sharply: attacks can deal far more damage.

super_power.name: Fortune's Favour
super_power.description: Luck soars: attacks can deal massive damage.

commanders.name: Shell
commanders.description: An old armadillo trader who knows every supplier in the woods. Units cost 10% less.

power.name: Haggle
power.description: Units cost half price.

super_power.name: Trading Post
super_power.description: Units cost half price and can be mustered at storehouses.

commanders.name: Ridge
commanders.description: A young coyote who loves open country. Units fight better on grass.

power.name: Stampede
power.description: Units on grass gain +10% attack; ground siege engines gain +1 range.

super_power.name: Open Range
super_power.description: Units on grass gain +30% attack; vehicles gain +2 movement.

commanders.name: Hollis
commanders.description: A hawk medic who keeps her troops in the fight. Units repair 1 extra HP on properties.

power.name: Second Wind
power.description: Luck rises: attacks can deal more damage.

super_power.name: Hailstorm
super_power.description: Three volleys of stones strike the enemy's densest groups for 2 HP each.

commanders.name: Frost
commanders.description: A hedgehog veteran of a hundred winters. Snow doesn't slow her troops.

power.name: Hoarfrost
power.description: Snow falls until her next turn.

super_power.name: Deep Winter
super_power.description: Snow falls and all enemy units lose 2 HP.

commanders.name: Grimjaw
commanders.description: A badger marksman. Indirect units hit harder and reach further; direct combat units are weaker.

power.name: Long Shot
power.description: Indirect units gain +1 range and +20% attack.

super_power.name: Deadeye
super_power.description: Indirect units gain +2 range and +20% attack.

commanders.name: Bjorn
commanders.description: A young fox heir with deep pockets. Units cost 20% less but have 10% less firepower.

power.name: Family Fortune
power.description: Funds grow by half.

super_power.name: Bought Loyalty
super_power.description: Attack rises with funds: +3.3% per 1000 held.

commanders.name: Sable
commanders.description: A stoat heiress with a knack for business. Each property earns 100 extra funds.

power.name: Run on the Bank
power.description: The enemy's power meter drains by 10% for every 5000 funds she holds.

super_power.name: Spoils of War
super_power.description: Gains funds worth half the damage her units deal.

commanders.name: Prowler
commanders.description: A cheetah who commands the skies. Fliers are strong and use less stamina; boats are weak.

power.name: Updraft
power.description: Fliers gain +5% attack and +10% defense.

super_power.name: Lightning Pounce
super_power.description: Every unit but foot soldiers can move and act again.

commanders.name: Tusker
commanders.description: An elephant admiral. Boats move further and defend better, rain doesn't bother him; fliers are weak.

power.name: Trumpet Wave
power.description: All enemy units lose 1 HP and half their stamina.

super_power.name: Monsoon
super_power.description: All enemy units lose 2 HP and half their stamina, and rain falls.

commanders.name: Rumble
commanders.description: A rhino who trusts in armour. Vehicles hit harder; everything else is weaker.

power.name: Charge Up
power.description: Vehicles gain +10% attack and +1 movement; all units are resupplied.

super_power.name: Full Gallop
super_power.description: Vehicles gain +30% attack and +2 movement; all units are resupplied.

commanders.name: Lionheart
commanders.description: A noble lion knight. Units shrug off indirect fire.

power.name: Shield Wall
power.description: Even more defense against indirect fire.

super_power.name: Pride's Bulwark
super_power.description: Indirect fire barely scratches his units.

commanders.name: Kira
commanders.description: A red panda empress whose elite troops are strong in attack and defense, but cost 20% more.

power.name: Rallying Cry
power.description: Units gain +20% attack.

super_power.name: Imperial Guard
super_power.description: Units gain +20% attack and defense, and counter-attacks deal 50% more.

commanders.name: Tanuki
commanders.description: A trickster who hides his army's strength. Enemies can't see his units' HP; +1 vision, but poorer luck.

power.name: Second Sight
power.description: Units gain +1 vision and see into thickets and lily pads.

super_power.name: Turnabout
super_power.description: Defenders strike back first; +1 vision and sight into cover.

commanders.name: Sensei
commanders.description: An old crane master of the air. Copters and foot soldiers are strong, transports move further; vehicles and boats are weak.

power.name: Call the Flock
power.description: Militia with 9 HP appear on every empty storehouse.

super_power.name: Sky Drop
super_power.description: Halberdiers with 9 HP appear on every empty storehouse.

commanders.name: Goro
commanders.description: A macaque brawler. Massive firepower, flimsy defense.

power.name: Knuckle Up
power.description: Units gain +20% attack.

super_power.name: Haymaker
super_power.description: Units gain +50% attack.

commanders.name: Dredge
commanders.description: A hulking skunk who fights wild. Damage swings with luck, good and bad.

power.name: Brute Swing
power.description: Luck swings wider: more damage, and more misses.

super_power.name: Rampage
super_power.description: Luck swings wildly: huge hits, or near misses.

commanders.name: Burrower
commanders.description: A mole tactician who uses every fold of the ground. Units gain attack for each terrain star they stand on.

power.name: Undermine
power.description: All terrain costs 1 to move through.

super_power.name: Warren Network
super_power.description: All terrain costs 1 to move through, and terrain defense doubles.

commanders.name: Wriggle
commanders.description: A shrew who slips through any gap. A stronger power meter makes up for no other gifts.

power.name: Slither
power.description: All units gain +1 movement.

super_power.name: Tunnel Rush
super_power.description: All units gain +2 movement.

commanders.name: Carapace
commanders.description: A pangolin general who wears his foes down. Units have 10% more firepower.

power.name: Blight
power.description: All enemy units lose 1 HP; all his units recover 1 HP.

super_power.name: Black Blight
super_power.description: All enemy units lose 2 HP; all his units recover 2 HP.

commanders.name: Hivemind
commanders.description: The anteater matriarch who rules the deep. Strong in attack and defense, and her army crosses any ground at cost 1.

power.name: Cave-In
power.description: The ground collapses on the enemy's densest group: 4 HP damage around it.

super_power.name: Sinkhole
super_power.description: A huge collapse: 8 HP damage around the enemy's densest group.

commanders.name: Clank
commanders.description: An aardvark sapper in riveted iron armour. Erratic: damage swings with luck.

power.name: Overwind
power.description: Luck swings wider still.

super_power.name: Spring Snap
super_power.description: Luck swings to extremes.

commanders.name: Cinder
commanders.description: A mole marshal who drives troops down every trail. Units fight better on trails.

power.name: Forced March
power.description: Units gain +1 movement; units on trails +10% attack.

super_power.name: Scorched Trail
super_power.description: Units gain +2 movement; units on trails +20% attack.

commanders.name: Velvet
commanders.description: A naked mole rat socialite who rules the burrow-towns. Units on properties fight much harder.

power.name: Rot
power.description: Enemy units on properties lose 3 HP; units on properties gain +40% attack.

super_power.name: High Society
super_power.description: Units on properties gain +90% attack, and all units +3% per property she owns.

commanders.name: Vesper
commanders.description: An ancient bat who sleeps beneath the roots. Units are stronger in attack and defense. No CO Power.

super_power.name: Root Shock
super_power.description: 3 HP damage around the enemy's densest group, and those units can't act next turn.
